english.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday noun for potato crisps.
Use this for thin, crisp pieces of fried potato; it is the everyday all-purpose choice for this food.

examples.english: I always have to eat a crisp while watching a movie.
examples.traditional: 我睇戲一定要食一塊薯片。
